title: Feeding the Hearth
sceneText:
There is a Forge-keeper waiting for you at the forge-chapel.

You have not been into that room yet. At the end of the west wing of the main house, a small stone room with a stone hearth set into it, the fire burning very low and very steady. The air smells of old smoke and cold stone.

A man in his fifties is crouched at the edge of the hearth, putting wood in. He waits a little after each piece.

{@lorenz}“Lorenz.” He does not get up. “I keep the three estates in this part of the valley.”

He puts in the last piece, watches the flames gather again, and only then stands and brushes the ash off his hands.

{@lorenz}“A new steward has taken over here, so I have come to feed it once. There is nothing particular in it. It is so the fire knows there has been a change.”

The Master starts for the door, and stops halfway.

{@lorenz}“As long as somebody tends the fire for it, the hearth stays alive. If nobody comes, it goes cold of itself.” He seems to remember something and turns back to you. “Also: I keep the vigil here on Thursday nights.”

“Keep the vigil over what?”

{@lorenz}“I sit and watch the fire into the small hours.”

{@lorenz}“The three estates’ forge-chapels take it in turn, and Maplegate has Thursdays.” Lorenz pushes the door open. “You are welcome to come and sit any Thursday night.”
